blurb: Danceworks of Miami offers dance classes in ballet, contemporary/lyrical, jazz, tap, acrobatics, and conditioning. They provide summer dance classes and a dance & theater summer camp for ages 7-14. The studio emphasizes positive self-image, love for dance, and stage experience through various performances and ensembles.
extraNote: Monthly tuition due by the 1st, late after the 15th with $10 late fee · Tuition required each month regardless of attendance unless class is dropped · No tuition credit for missed classes; studio closed on major holidays · Make-up classes must be taken within 30 days of return · $40 costume deposit due with January tuition; no costume ordered without deposit · All summer tuition due in full by first day of classes · Studio and office located on the east side of Publix, near The UPS Store and American Karate Institute, in the Crossings Shopping Center.
